explanation: I found no other declaration stating that the image of Icc a b under Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ is Icc (a : ℤ) b. I read Mathlib/Data/Nat/Cast/SetInterval.lean, where this theorem lives. The proof applies the general lemma OrderEmbedding.image_Icc (Mathlib/Order/Interval/Set/OrdConnected.lean). That lemma needs an OrdConnected hypothesis on the range of the embedding. Using it here also needs castOrderEmbedding and the fact that the range is Ici 0. Together that is more than a one- or two-line instantiation. I grepped for image_Icc, natCast '' Icc, Nat.cast '' Icc and similar. Hits were the Fin, ENNReal, ℚ and ℚ≥0 variants, and the sibling lemmas in the same file. None of these state the ℕ → ℤ result.
